about: What a person can do in Slatrix, and whether each app does it. AGENTS.md says how to keep it current.

capabilities.what: The app has its own icon in the Dock or launcher.
Choose light, dark or the system's appearance, and a sidebar theme.
Zoom the whole interface from 80% to 200% with ⌘= and ⌘-.
capabilities.android: n/a: Android scales with the system font size instead

capabilities.what: The app updates itself to new releases.
capabilities.android: n/a: an Android app updates through the store or installer it came from

capabilities.what: A banner says when you're offline and leaves when the connection returns.
In a narrow window the sidebar becomes a drawer and side panes cover the conversation.
capabilities.android: n/a: a phone shows one screen at a time

capabilities.what: Drag the edges of the sidebar and the thread pane to resize them.
capabilities.android: n/a: Android screens fill the window

capabilities.what: Sign in to any Matrix server with a password or single sign-on.
Reopening the app keeps you signed in.
Sign out.
Switch between workspaces, which are Matrix spaces.
See a workspace's channels and direct messages together.
See every direct message, newest first, with its latest message.
Unread conversations show in bold, and mentions show a count.
Starred conversations sit in their own section at the top.
Star or unstar a conversation.
Collapse a section, keeping its open and unread conversations in view.
Private channels show a lock where public ones show #.
Browse a workspace's or the server's channels and join one.
Create a channel in a workspace.
Accept or decline an invitation to a channel, direct message or workspace.
Move to the previous, next or next unread conversation from the keyboard.
capabilities.android: n/a: phones switch conversations by touch

capabilities.what: Find a conversation by name and open it.
Find people by name or Matrix ID.
Search messages, encrypted ones included, with in: and from: filters.
Search offers your recent searches.
A conversation opens at its newest messages and loads older ones as you scroll up.
The start of a conversation shows its intro.
Day dividers read Today, Yesterday or the date.
Messages one person sends within five minutes group under one name.
A conversation opens at a New line above its first unread message.
Reading a conversation's newest messages marks it read.
Mark a conversation, or every conversation, read.
Mark a conversation unread.
Coming back to a conversation returns to where you were reading.
A message opened from search or a link shows highlighted in its conversation.
See a conversation's members from its header.
See the files and links shared in a conversation.
See a conversation's pinned messages.
Choose when a conversation notifies you.
Edit a channel's name and topic.
Invite people to a channel or workspace.
Add a channel to another workspace, or take it out.
Leave a channel.
A channel you can't post in says so in place of the composer.
Send a text message.
Format a message with bold, italic, strikethrough, code, lists, quotes and links.
An unsent message stays in its conversation's composer.
Mention someone by picking them from an @ list.
Attach files and images with +, by dragging or by pasting.
Others see when you're typing.
Press ↑ in an empty composer to edit your last message.
capabilities.android: n/a: phone keyboards have no arrow keys

capabilities.what: Formatted messages show bold, italic, code, lists, quotes, links and spoilers.
Mentions show as names in pills, with yours highlighted.
Links to Matrix rooms, messages and people open in the app.
A reply shows the message it quotes.
An edited message shows its new text, marked (edited).
A deleted message shows as deleted and keeps nothing it said.
Images show inline, with their space kept while they load.
Videos show inline with a poster and their length.
Files show as a tile you can open.
Open an image or video full size and step through the conversation's media.
Reactions show under a message with their counts, yours marked, and who reacted.
Tap a reaction to add yours or take it back.
A thread's first message shows its reply count, who replied and when.
Your message shows while it sends, and one that failed can be retried or deleted.
Messages written offline go out once the connection returns.
React with one of your recent emoji straight from a message.
Pick any emoji to react with, searching by name or shortcode.
Reply to a message with a quote of it.
Copy a message's text.
Copy a link to a message.
Edit your own message.
Delete your own message.
Forward a message to another conversation.
Pin or unpin a message.
Save a message for later and find it again in Later.
Change the caption of an image or file you sent.
Open a message's thread.
Reply in a thread.
Send a thread reply to the channel too.
Reading a thread marks it read.
A notification for a thread reply opens it in its thread.
Threads lists the threads you're in, newest reply first.
Activity lists your mentions, replies and invitations.
Opening an Activity item shows its message in its conversation or thread.
Open someone's profile from their name.
Message someone from their profile, reusing your direct message with them.
People and conversations show a photo, or initials on a color.
See your own profile.
Change your display name.
Change or remove your profile photo, cropped to a square.
A new message that should notify you raises a notification.
Opening a notification opens its conversation.
The app asks for permission before it notifies.
Hide message text in notifications.
Choose how direct messages and group conversations notify you by default.
Confirm this device by comparing emoji with another of your devices.
Unlock encrypted history with a recovery key.
Conversations stay hidden until this device's identity is confirmed.
